items.name: 4af-theme
items.title: 4AF Theme
items.description: The semantic colors, radii, shadows, typography, and motion tokens used by 4AF components.

.shimmer-text.animate-text-shimmer::afte.background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent calc(50% - var(--text-shimmer-spread, 4ch)), var(--text-shimmer-highlight) 50%, transparent calc(50% + var(--text-shimmer-spread, 4ch)))

items.name: refs
items.description: React 19-safe callback and object ref composition.

items.name: motion
items.description: Spring and easing presets, mirroring the CSS motion tokens.

items.name: use-action
items.description: Shared async action state with a double-submit guard and reset timer. Outcome callbacks still fire after unmount; local feedback and timers stop.

items.name: table-of-contents-scroll
items.description: Table-of-contents scroll helpers for endpoint padding, active-entry centering, and overflow-edge affordances.

items.name: table-of-contents-tracking
items.description: Shared heading tracking and click-to-scroll behavior for table-of-contents variants.

items.name: loader
items.description: Small context and loading slot for caller-supplied indicators, with ClassicLoader as the fallback.

items.name: button
items.description: Six variants, eight sizes, optical icon alignment, and a loading state that preserves size and keyboard focus while blocking activation.

items.name: button-group
items.description: Related Buttons joined horizontally or vertically, with flattened inner corners and variant-specific seams. Each button keeps its own tab stop.

items.name: input
items.description: A Base UI input with token-based surfaces, focus states, an optional leading icon, custom number steppers, and default, plain, and underline variants.

items.name: separator
items.description: An accessible horizontal or vertical divider built on Base UI Separator.

items.name: textarea
items.description: A multiline text field with bordered or plain variants, neutral or accent focus styling, and an optional resize handle.

items.name: alert
items.description: An inline status line — a glyph plus a sentence, no surface. Destructive error (role=alert), amber warning, green success, neutral info, and a muted loading line with ClassicLoader by default.

items.name: toggle
items.description: A button with a persistent pressed state and optional icon fill.

items.name: morph
items.description: Animated content swap — icons or text. Copy to check, Follow to Following.

items.name: delete-button
items.description: A destructive button that arms on the first press and confirms on the second, with Escape, blur, and timeout exits.

items.name: copy-button
items.description: Copies to the clipboard and confirms it visually and to screen readers, preserving keyboard focus while pending.

items.name: action-button
items.description: Runs an async action, shows pending/success/error, and resets after feedback. Preserves focus while pending and reserves its widest state; pending can keep its label or show a centered loader only.

items.name: action-toggle
items.description: A toggle that changes state after its action succeeds, preserves its previous state on failure, and keeps keyboard focus while pending.

items.name: tabs
items.description: Segment, pill, or underline tabs with an animated indicator, optional counts, and horizontal scrolling.

items.name: switch
items.description: A switch whose thumb stretches toward the track center on hover and further when pressed, then returns to a circle as it slides. Adaptive or fixed thumb tone.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: A checkbox whose tick draws itself in. Presses on click, not on hover.

items.name: radio
items.description: A radio group — the Checkbox's sibling, a single choice with a dot that scales in.

items.name: slider
items.description: A slider with bar, knob, and circle variants. Tracks the pointer while dragged and glides on track clicks and keyboard steps, with optional range mode, labels, editable values, a live value tooltip, and a custom fill colour. Base UI behaviour.

items.name: progress
items.description: A determinate progress bar with composable label and formatted value parts. Base UI Progress behaviour; the fill animates with transform instead of width.

items.name: badge
items.description: A status badge with animated content changes, optional icons or dots, and plain, solid, or outline styles.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: A muted placeholder with square corners by default, shaped by utility classes. Pulses while content loads; reduced motion disables the pulse.

items.name: collapsible
items.description: A disclosure row built on Base UI Collapsible: the chevron rotates, the space slides open so the rows below travel rather than jump, and the content fades in out of a blur where it lands.

items.name: table
items.description: A presentational semantic table with a composable caption, two densities, an optional outline and row / column lines, a pinned header, and loading skeletons. Install data-table for selection, sort controls, and row actions.

items.name: data-table
items.description: A table with row selection, sort controls, bulk actions, and row menus. The caller orders the data.

items.name: table-of-contents
items.description: A table of contents that tracks visible headings, keeps the last passed section active through long prose, and offers spanning or single-heading markers.

items.name: table-of-contents-lines
items.description: A line-based table of contents with a longer rule per heading, shorter content rules between headings, and a highlighted, expanding hover treatment.

items.name: empty
items.description: An empty state — a centred column of media, title, description and an action. Composable parts; borderless by default with an optional dashed placeholder outline.

items.name: text-shimmer
items.description: Text with a highlight sweeping across it — a looping working-in-progress affordance. Gradient clipped to the glyphs, switched off (not sped up) under reduced motion.

items.name: scramble-text
items.description: A short random-character reveal for text that is appearing or changing, with whitespace preservation and reduced-motion support.

items.name: blur-text
items.description: Text that blurs and rises into place letter by letter or word by word. A CSS entrance for headings and short lines, shown at once under reduced motion.

items.name: select
items.description: Single or multiple selection with optional search, nested options, and footer actions.

items.name: command-palette
items.description: A keyboard-first command and search palette with nested panels, custom panel content, fuzzy filtering, async/server-driven and paginated search, keybind hints, panel tab bars with Tab/Shift+Tab switching, and Base UI dialog/autocomplete behavior.

items.name: ascii-loader
items.description: A looping braille spinner for compact async status affordances.

items.name: matrix-loader
items.description: A 4×4 matrix dot loader with scan, twinkle, and size variants.

items.name: classic-loader
items.description: Twelve fading radial bars adapted from loading.dev, with CSS-only motion, size variants, and speed control.

items.name: select-aligned
items.description: A single-select menu that aligns the selected option with its trigger when space and input method allow.

items.name: select-search
items.description: A searchable single or multi-select on Base UI's Combobox — type to filter the list, with full keyboard and ARIA support. Multi-select keeps its animated checkbox list open while choices are toggled.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: Base UI positioning and timing with a CSS scale-and-blur enter. Opens on hover and focus, flips at the viewport edge, and layers above modal content.

items.name: selection-toolbar
items.description: A floating toolbar for selected text, with action buttons, async actions, and toggles.

items.name: sheet
items.description: A dialog that slides in from an edge. Base UI Dialog behaviour, Motion enter/exit.

items.name: dialog
items.description: A modal centred over the page with Base UI Dialog behaviour and Motion transitions. Optional steps keep the dialog open when completion validation fails.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.description: A confirmation dialog that blocks backdrop dismissal. Escape and close controls dismiss it.

items.name: date-picker
items.description: Date and date-range fields with a popover and consistent sizing on every device, medium or numeric date labels, and a standalone Calendar with a month / year picker.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.description: A breadcrumb trail with links, separators, and expandable middle items.

items.name: popover
items.description: An interactive panel anchored to a trigger. Base UI Popover behaviour with a CSS scale-and-blur enter from the trigger edge.

items.name: hover-card
items.description: A rich preview of what is behind a link, on hover and focus. Base UI PreviewCard behaviour with a CSS scale-and-blur enter from the trigger edge, plus a built-in loading skeleton.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.description: A dropdown menu on Base UI Menu (keyboard nav, submenus, checkbox/radio items, searchable selection panels, and immediate disabled-reason tooltips). Instant row highlight; CSS scale-and-blur panel enter.

items.name: sidebar
items.description: A collapsible application sidebar with default, floating, inset, and split layouts, animated split-rail icon tooltips, collapsible rows with built-in chevrons, nested rows, actions, badges, and loading skeletons.

items.name: sidebar-layout
items.description: An optional viewport shell composing Sidebar with independently scrolling content, a surface-colored header with a title or custom content, header actions, and a left-aligned collapse trigger.
